system.description: Beginning at 6th level, you know that there’s magic inherent to any flower meadow. When you first gain this feature, select 3 spells of a level you can cast from the healing, nature, plants, or terrain schools as your meadow magic. You may select two additional meadow magic spells at your 7th, 9th, and 11th druid levels. You always have your meadow magic spells prepared, and they do not count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you select a spell that does not appear on the druid spell list, it counts as a druid spell for you.
